summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting a temporary suspension of its share buyback programme due to its pending acquisition of Webster Financial Corporation. The buyback is suspended from 24 April 2026 (when the proxy statement/prospectus is mailed for the stockholder vote) through 26 May 2026 (the stockholder meeting date), and is expected to resume on 27 May 2026. No deal terms are provided in this filing. The stock-for-stock acquisition has all-share consideration, requiring Santander to pause buybacks to comply with U.S. regulations. The key event to watch is the Webster stockholder vote on 26 May 2026; a favorable vote would allow the buyback to resume and the acquisition to proceed.
